scientific_question: Does a Parent-nested, Q72-driven aquatic hydraulic-exposure operator improve monthly TN prediction while retaining the frozen eta_quick/eta_gw readout, and only then does an aquatic-temperature proxy add further information?

aquatic_operator.route_equation: L_out=upstream_term+local_term for quick and GW N separately
aquatic_operator.temperature_stage: conditional only after hydraulic-only gate passes

stage0.expected_missing_reaction_fingerprint: within-station log residual obs-minus-pred tends to decrease as hydraulic or thermal exposure increases
stage0.plausibility_role: non-blocking and not a model-selection gate

temperature_contract.aquatic_role: modelled lake mixed-layer temperature proxy; not observed stream temperature
temperature_contract.groundwater_product: Benz et al. 2024 static 2020 state and 2000-2020 change
temperature_contract.groundwater_role: provenance audit only; forbidden in aquatic operator

difference_from_20260820_3.20260820_3: replaced eta_quick/eta_gw with groundwater and aquatic survival parameters
difference_from_20260820_3.20260820_18: retains and independently refits the same eta_quick/eta_gw readout for each candidate fold; adds one Parent-nested aquatic term

stage1_hydraulic_temporal_screen.temperature: Q10 fixed exactly 1; no temperature column enters routing
stage1_hydraulic_temporal_screen.optimizer: registered grid followed by bounded scalar refinement around the best interior grid point; ties within 1e-8 select the smaller v_f
stage1_hydraulic_temporal_screen.independent_readout: each model x fold x layer independently fits v_f, eta_quick, eta_gw and the frozen-form P2 station effect where applicable
stage1_hydraulic_temporal_screen.parent_comparator: matched UNIFORM_PARENT model x fold x layer
stage1_hydraulic_temporal_screen.pass_role: authorizes nested spatial hydraulic evaluation; does not yet authorize temperature
stage1_hydraulic_temporal_screen.fail_role: hydraulic operator not supported; temperature cannot rescue it

claim_boundary.hydraulic_only_success: TN OOF supports an effective Q72-driven aquatic hydraulic-exposure term
claim_boundary.temperature_success: TN OOF supports modulation by the registered LMLT temperature proxy
